highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM alignment and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL on .NET 9.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9
bullets.detail: The WinUI Projection assembly is now packaged so .NET 9 consumers can load it without a DllNotFoundException at startup.

bullets.lead: Apple TFM alignment: versioned library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs
bullets.detail: Backports the Apple TFM changes from main so that libraries target versioned Apple TFMs (26.0) and sample apps use the unversioned forms, matching current .NET SDK guidance.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple platform TFM alignment to the 3.119.x servicing line
